source_issue.title: Auto-generated text-area form fields should have at least 10 lines by default and should increase size as the user types in text

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue aims to enhance the text-area form fields in the Volto framework by ensuring they have at least 10 lines by default and can dynamically increase in size as users type. This will help users see all their text without scrolling.

## What needs to be done
1. Update the Textarea widget to have a default of 10 rows.
2. Implement functionality to allow the textarea to resize as the user types.
3. Possible integration of the `react-textarea-autosize` module may be required for this feature.

## Helpful background
The discussions indicate a desire to improve user experience with text areas. Current implementations might be limited due to CSS restrictions from `semantic-ui-react`, so exploring alternatives like `react-textarea-autosize` could be beneficial. Note that the conversation includes references to contributing guidelines and requirements for first-time contributors.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the relevant part of the codebase, particularly the `src/components/manage/Widgets/TextareaWidget.jsx`.
2. Explore the potential usage of the `react-textarea-autosize` module.
3. Review the [Plone contributing guidelines](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html) to understand the expectations for contributions.
4. Test your changes to ensure they work as intended before submitting a pull request.
```
